reviews.review:
This game is actually fantastic. 

The combat is fast and mostly intuitive although there are a few design choices that prevent me from playing as aggressively as I normally do. The mines that some enemies are quite annoying as they trigger as soon as their thrown instead of when they land, which can make melee a bit tricky although its still viable once you adapt your kiting techniques. Several of the guns in the game are just bad and really need to have something added to make them viable but in general the gunplay is fantastic. 

And movement in the game is mostly ok the developers have embraced a nice degree of verticality. The rails need a bit more work added to them as right now they tend to be traps that will interrupt your upwards/sideways momentum if you get near them. And the rails also trap you once you reach the end of the rail as you tend to keep bouncing off of the end instead of dismounting.

The graphics and the art style is solid. Most of the robots are quite endearing in their design. And in general the graphics are solid, not trying to push them to much just sticking to what works. The game does tend to chug at higher resolutions however.

All in all I like this game and I hope to see alot of stuff added as the game gets finished. Can't wait for the completed game.

I personally feel like it's one of the better roguelike fps games, at least among the ones I have tried. I played this during early accces, while I didn't play it enough to say what they improved, I have played enough to recommend it.

annoying levels, collectibles are just asinine super mario platforming in a run and gun shooter. felt incredibly boring, graphics is nice, but core aspect gameplay is totally botched for me.


If the dev drops the wannabe platforming for collectible crap and makes level generation more interesting this might be a good game, in this state i wont give it another chance.

I wouldnt even get it on a discount, kinda glad it was from humble, otherwise id refund!
Even in Early Access this game is absolutely phenomenal!

This game answers the question that nobody was asking but everyone should have been:
"What happens if you take DOOM combat mechanics, mix them with the random loot from Borderlands and turns the whole thing into a CO-OP roguelite ala. Risk of rain?"

Turns out the answer is: Fun! Fun happens if you do that!

This is undoubtably one of the best looter-shooters I've played in a long while and refreshingly I could play it PvE in CO-OP with a friend. Most of the games mechanics are pretty tight, and the rest of them I'm sure will evolve as the game progresses through development. I've had a lot of fun with this little game and I'm super looking forwards to the updates of the future!

It's not currently the longest game in the world, but I'm sure it will get more content, and I've already spent almost 20 hours in it hanging out with a good friend, and I could spend more if I wanted to experiment with all the different loot, ability and skill combinations.

The artstyle is also very striking. Very styilized but also very clean, clear and pretty.
